description: This skill should be used when acceptance tests must be designed from an approved spec and ux.md in a context that has not seen the implementation — mapping each AC-n to a test level and cases, covering UX states, accessibility and non-functional thresholds, proving every test red at the base commit, then running them at the PR head with a verification-gap check and, on the Full path, a time-boxed exploratory session (acceptance-test design after Design sign-off and the Test stage of the Agentic SDLC).

queries.query: Design sign-off is done for specs/003-search-filters — write acceptance-tests.md from the spec before Build starts
Which test level should each acceptance criterion get — unit, integration or end-to-end?
Map every state in ux.md to a test or a UX check for the export feature
The spec says p95 under 800 ms for 50k rows; how do we test that non-functional requirement properly?
Run the acceptance tests at the PR head and record the evidence for the Test stage
We're on the Full path — plan and run the 30-minute exploratory testing session for the checkout redesign
Add end-to-end tests for this feature using whatever e2e framework the repo already has
Check whether our acceptance tests would actually catch a regression — any verification gaps?
Act as the Test Engineer: derive tests from the approved spec without looking at the implementation
Write WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility checks for the new settings dialog based on ux.md
Write the failing unit test for task T3 and make it pass with minimal code
Fill in the PR Verification table and check that the evidence is fresh before I claim it's done
Review this diff for correctness, design and security issues
Write the acceptance criteria for the new invite flow in spec.md
Build a threat model with abuse cases for the payment webhook

Set up the CI pipeline gates and branch protection for the Test and Release sign-offs
Break the approved spec into plan tasks with dependencies for Design sign-off
